"""Validate the final selection/hosted acceptance docs without rerunning native suites."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from freeze_native_release_298 import ROOT, OUT, sources

D = OUT / 'selection-documentation-411b'
D.mkdir()
frozen = json.loads((OUT / 'selection-check-source-409.json').read_text())
assert sources() == frozen['source_sha256']


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


assert sha(ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci.yml') == frozen['workflow_sha256']
commands = [
    ('user-surface', [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_user_surface_reference.py']),
    ('public-status', [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_public_status_docs.py', '--output', str(D / 'public-status.json')]),
    ('use-case-backlinks', [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_use_case_backlinks.py']),
    ('contribution-governance', [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_contribution_governance.py', '--output', str(D / 'contribution-governance.json')]),
    ('ci-gate-matrix', [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/check_ci_gate_matrix.py', '--output', str(D / 'ci-gate-matrix.json')]),
    ('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check']),
]
completed = []
for name, command in commands:
    path = D / f'{name}.log'
    start = time.monotonic()
    with path.open('xb') as f:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=180)
    row = dict(name=name, command=command, returncode=result.returncode,
               seconds=time.monotonic()-start, log=path.name, log_sha256=sha(path))
    completed.append(row)
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    result.check_returncode()

changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines()
added = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).splitlines()
documents = sorted(name for name in set(changed + added) if name.endswith('.md'))
links = []
for name in documents:
    path = ROOT / name
    for target in re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\s)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if target.startswith(('https:', 'http:', 'mailto:', '#')):
            continue
        local = target.split('#', 1)[0]
        destination = (path.parent / local).resolve()
        assert destination.exists(), (name, target)
        links.append(dict(document=name, target=target))
assert sources() == frozen['source_sha256']
assert sha(ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci.yml') == frozen['workflow_sha256']
summary = dict(status='passed', checks=completed, local_links=links,
    document_sha256={name:sha(ROOT / name) for name in documents},
    selected_sources_unchanged=2241, workflow_sha256=frozen['workflow_sha256'],
    helper_sha256=sha(__file__), helper_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    original_argument_failure={name:dict(sha256=sha(OUT / name), contents=(OUT / name).read_text())
        for name in ('selection-documentation411.json', 'selection-documentation411.log',
                     'selection-documentation-411/user-surface.log',
                     'finish_selection_docs_411_before_argument_fix.py')},
    limitations=['No website source changed; this is document/link validation, not a new rendered website observation.',
                 'Native gates are reused only for the exact unchanged accepted source set.'])
(D / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed', checks=len(completed), documents=len(documents), links=len(links))))
